limits: Native checks use owned offline fixtures through the actual launcher-built executable; Java checks use supported development-toolchain clients.
No fresh external-server, arbitrary-modpack, endurance, alternate graphics backend or published-Java-jar personal-launcher acceptance is claimed.
The official native build uses the launcher CLI; no fresh GUI Build/Play claim is made for this update. The existing user game and personal worlds are left untouched.
harness_repairs: The new optional HUD override is polled until it exists, matching the existing interface harness.
The normal client-side waypoint command uses visible chat; chat is then hidden for screenshots. The failed fixture attempts are retained privately, and runtime source was unchanged.
